gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-fira-sans: Fuzzy Bubbles writes in rounded, drafting-pen lines that feel personal and unhurried. And Fira Sans sits underneath in a plain sans, its generous x-height and uniform strokes tidying up what the heading loosens.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-public-sans: Soft, scribbled charm up top, then sturdy ground below, since Fuzzy Bubbles curves match its stems in thickness. Shrink the heading too far and it loses its friendliness, while Public Sans stays solid.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-fs-supreme: Relaxed is the first word for Fuzzy Bubbles, with rope-fine strokes shaped into rounded, friendly letters. But Supreme brings a heavy, crisp band of plain sans text, and the heading does its best work big and brief.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-general-sans: Lowercase letters nearly as tall as the capitals give Fuzzy Bubbles a stubby, hand-inked look that feels instantly personal. It excels at casual character, while General Sans handles smooth, steady sans-serif text.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-manrope: Small letters that almost match the capitals give Fuzzy Bubbles its cheerful, drafting-pen look and a very personal feel. Manrope follows in sans-serif with bright open curves, while the heading earns its place large and short.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-satoshi: Loose, friendly, a bit like a doodled label. Make Fuzzy Bubbles small and that charm gets lost, whereas Satoshi's tall, sans-serif letters with wide-open e shapes hold up at any size.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-switzer: Switzer reads like fine wire bent into tall, open letters, tidy in a Swiss, approachable way. Fuzzy Bubbles adds a handwritten, rounded warmth over that plain sans.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-work-sans: Casual scrawl meets modern tidiness here. Shrink Fuzzy Bubbles and its drafting-pen softness fades, but Work Sans, a plain sans with high mean lines and sturdy joins, stays crisp and contemporary.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-bespoke-sans: Hand-drawn letters, stretched wide and glassy. Hachi Maru Pop brings the playful warmth, and Bespoke Sans adds a sharp, refined sans with generous room where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-hachi-maru-pop-fs-literata: Relaxed and inviting, Hachi Maru Pop spaces its hand-drawn letters out loosely. Literata, a bookish serif with gentle hairline thinning and open curves, gives that looseness something sophisticated to rest against.
